_comment: Examples the docs team has reviewed and judged won't-fix, so the SQL-sample checker (run_sql_samples.py) stops re-reporting them. Keyed by 'fingerprint' (sample_fingerprint: a content hash, not file:line) so an entry survives the block moving and re-surfaces if the example text meaningfully changes. Categories: version-gated | illustrative | needs-setup | expected-error. Optional 'versions' (e.g. ["3.5"] or ["3.5","4.0"]) scopes an entry to the major.minor versions where the example is durably-not-runnable; omit it (or use []) for a global entry that is suppressed on every version — the default and original behavior. Scope version-gated entries; leave illustrative/expected-error global. Entries are added by the sql-doc-autofix skill in a reviewed PR — never auto-committed. file/line/snippet are human context only; matching is by fingerprint.
